name: agent-team-development
description: End-to-end Agent Teams orchestration for cross-cutting work requiring inter-agent communication and worktree isolation.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate multi-agent work with worktree isolation.
interface.longDescription: A workflow for cross-cutting changes that need inter-agent communication: splitting work across agents, isolating each in its own git worktree, and cherry-picking results back together. Written for Claude Code Agent Teams; on other hosts the leader coordinates agents directly.
defaultPrompt: Plan this cross-layer change as an agent team
Split this refactor across agents in separate worktrees
